SHIONTHEBRUISER-BATTLE_RAGS.description: At the start of your turn, gain [blue]1[/blue] [gold]Scrappy[/gold].
SHIONTHEBRUISER-BATTLE_RAGS.flavor: 'Don't look at me like that. They still do the job.' - Shion
SHIONTHEBRUISER-BATTLE_RAGS.title: Battle Rags
SHIONTHEBRUISER-BATTLE_GLOVES.descriptio: Every card you play grants its [gold]Scrappy[/gold] bonus.
SHIONTHEBRUISER-BATTLE_GLOVES.flavor: 'Huh... I guess it IS more comfortable.' - Shion
SHIONTHEBRUISER-BATTLE_GLOVES.title: Battle Gloves
SHIONTHEBRUISER-UPGRADINATOR.description: TEST!!! Upgrades all cards at the start of the next fight.
SHIONTHEBRUISER-UPGRADINATOR.flavor: If you see this, I fucked up. - the Dev
SHIONTHEBRUISER-UPGRADINATOR.title: Upgradinator
SHIONTHEBRUISER-SPIKES_GLOVES.descriptio: Your Strikes and Energy Attacks deal {Damage:diff()} additional damage.
SHIONTHEBRUISER-SPIKES_GLOVES.flavor: It's a bad look, but is it a worse look than the rags you started with?
SHIONTHEBRUISER-SPIKES_GLOVES.title: Spiked Gloves
SHIONTHEBRUISER-COMMANDER_CAP.flavor: Apparently, he keeps an entire stock of those things...
SHIONTHEBRUISER-COMMANDER_CAP.title: Commander Cap
SHIONTHEBRUISER-PURPLE_CHAOS_EMERALD.des: At the start of each combat, shuffle a [gold]Vision[/gold] into your [gold]Draw Pile[/gold].
SHIONTHEBRUISER-PURPLE_CHAOS_EMERALD.fla: This gem of incredible power is drawn to those who show great intuition.
SHIONTHEBRUISER-S_MONITOR.description: At the start of each combat, gain [blue]1[/blue] [gold]Buffer[/gold].
SHIONTHEBRUISER-S_MONITOR.flavor: Note: only to use in the Chao Garden or as part of comedy routines. Do not use for actual battle.
SHIONTHEBRUISER-S_MONITOR.title: S Monitor
SHIONTHEBRUISER-CHAO_EGGSHELL.descriptio: Whenever you would lose HP, lose {ReductionAmount:diff()} less for each time you already took damage this turn.
SHIONTHEBRUISER-CHAO_EGGSHELL.flavor: Do you think Shions grow out of an egg, too?
SHIONTHEBRUISER-CHAO_EGGSHELL.title: Chao Eggshell
SHIONTHEBRUISER-EDGE_THE_CHAO.descriptio: Whenever you consume [gold]Vigor[/gold], gain {RefundPercent:diff()}% of it (rounded down, up to {RefundCap:diff()}) as [gold]Vigor[/gold] next turn.
SHIONTHEBRUISER-EDGE_THE_CHAO.flavor: Shion's trusted and beloved little guy. Wants to be a Berserker when he grows up, too.
SHIONTHEBRUISER-EDGE_THE_CHAO.title: Edge The Chao
SHIONTHEBRUISER-RING_MONITOR.description: Whenever you would lose HP, {BlockChance:diff()}% chance to lose {BlockAmount:diff()} less.
SHIONTHEBRUISER-RING_MONITOR.flavor: There is probably a cynical remark to make about currency being able to protect you from harm.
SHIONTHEBRUISER-RING_MONITOR.title: Ring Monitor
SHIONTHEBRUISER-SOUVENIR_PICTURE.descrip: If you end your turn without using a [gold]Berserk[/gold] effect, gain {VigorAmount:diff()} [gold]Vigor[/gold] at the start of your next turn.
SHIONTHEBRUISER-SOUVENIR_PICTURE.flavor: There is a phone number on the back of the frame. There is also a claw mark for some reason...?
SHIONTHEBRUISER-SOUVENIR_PICTURE.title: Souvenir Picture
SHIONTHEBRUISER-ABBY_THE_ABSOL.descripti:
At the start of each combat, summon [gold]Abby[/gold].
Gain {CritAttackRate:diff()}% [gold]Critical Hit[/gold] chance.
Whenever you deal [gold]Critical[/gold] damage to an enemy, [gold]Abby[/gold] deals the same damage to it.
SHIONTHEBRUISER-ABBY_THE_ABSOL.flavor: Former Shadow Pokémon, now mascot and daughter, the ever-vigilant Abby watches over Shion more than the other way around.
SHIONTHEBRUISER-ABBY_THE_ABSOL.title: Abby the Absol
SHIONTHEBRUISER-THORN_RING.title: Thorn Ring
SHIONTHEBRUISER-THORN_RING.description: At the start of each combat, add {Cards:diff()} [gold]Come What May[/gold] to your [gold]Hand[/gold].
SHIONTHEBRUISER-THORN_RING.flavor: The mere sight of this item make the frail-hearted tremble. For someone desperate for power, however...
SHIONTHEBRUISER-TURTLE_HERMIT_SHELL.desc:
Replace your starter [gold]Deck[/gold] with one focused on Energy moves.
Your [gold]Berserk[/gold] threshold is reduced by {BerserkThresholdReduction:diff()}% of your Max HP.
SHIONTHEBRUISER-TURTLE_HERMIT_SHELL.flav: Eat well, play well, and rest well! It's the Turtle School's way!
SHIONTHEBRUISER-MASTER_BALL.title: Master Ball
SHIONTHEBRUISER-MASTER_BALL.description:
Gain [gold]Abby the Absol[/gold], [gold]Show of Strength[/gold] and [gold]Press the Advantage[/gold].
Lose {HpLoss:diff()} Max HP.
SHIONTHEBRUISER-MASTER_BALL.flavor: When Shion snagged Abby, she used a Master Ball, clueless to how expensive it was. She owes up to it, though. It's a good proof of love.
SHIONTHEBRUISER-MASTER_PENDANT.descripti: You can [gold]Lull[/gold] at Rest Sites to add a strong card to your Deck.
SHIONTHEBRUISER-MASTER_PENDANT.flavor: It's said that the Master Emerald's existence is shared across space and time. Somewhere, somewhen, someone is VERY confused why a shard of the Master Emerald is suddenly flying upwards.
SHIONTHEBRUISER-MASTER_PENDANT.title: Master Emerald Shard Pendant
SHIONTHEBRUISER-MASTER_PENDANT.cardSelec:
You feel a quiet, serene presence from the Pendant.
Choose a card to add to your Deck.
SHIONTHEBRUISER-MASTER_PENDANT.rest_desc: Add a [gold]powerful card[/gold] to your Deck.
SHIONTHEBRUISER-SPEED_SHOES.description: Whenever you play a Strike, draw [blue]1[/blue] card.
SHIONTHEBRUISER-SPEED_SHOES.flavor: Dr.Eggman says it's just a placebo. Sonic says they legit make you faster. Somehow, they're both correct.
SHIONTHEBRUISER-SPEED_SHOES.title: Speed Shoes
SHIONTHEBRUISER-MAID_OUTFIT.description: The first time you play an Energy card each turn, gain {Energy:energyIcons()}.
SHIONTHEBRUISER-MAID_OUTFIT.flavor: 'I wish I could get rid of that damned thing already. BUT IT'S MADE OUT OF ME AND I'M BLOODY STURDY!' - Shion
SHIONTHEBRUISER-MAID_OUTFIT.title: Suspicious, Rotten, Disgusting, Forgotten, Stupid Outfit
SHIONTHEBRUISER-SCOPE_LENS.flavor: 'But I'm not a Pokémon', you think. 'It won't work on me', you think. Well, about that...
SHIONTHEBRUISER-SCOPE_LENS.title: Scope Lens
SHIONTHEBRUISER-CHOICE_BAND.description: If you play exactly [blue]1[/blue] Attack in a turn, gain {VigorAmount:diff()} [gold]Vigor[/gold] at the start of your next turn.
SHIONTHEBRUISER-CHOICE_BAND.flavor: Did you know? Putting a head band on Shion's head stunlocks her. If you put a Choice Band on her head, though...
SHIONTHEBRUISER-CHOICE_BAND.title: Choice Band
SHIONTHEBRUISER-SHELL_BELL.description:
Gain {CritHitRate:diff()}% [gold]Critical Hit[/gold] chance.
Whenever you deal a [gold]Critical Hit[/gold], heal {Heal:diff()} HP.
SHIONTHEBRUISER-SHELL_BELL.flavor: ring ring make feel brain so nicey it heal me
SHIONTHEBRUISER-SHELL_BELL.title: Shell Bell
SHIONTHEBRUISER-MASTER_ARTISAN_CLEAT.des: At the start of combat, add {Cards:diff()} random Rare Colourless {Cards:plural:card|cards} to your [gold]Hand[/gold]. {Cards:plural:It is|They are} free to play this combat.
SHIONTHEBRUISER-MASTER_ARTISAN_CLEAT.fla: Umamusume (and Shion) wear these. Maybe you haven't guessed it yet, but horse girls are very high maintenance!
SHIONTHEBRUISER-GRILLED_CARROT.descripti: Whenever you take an action other than Rest at a Rest Site, heal {Heal:diff()} HP.
SHIONTHEBRUISER-GRILLED_CARROT.flavor: A healthy snack that fills your energy right back up. Don't overeat, though! Think of your poor metabolism!
SHIONTHEBRUISER-GRILLED_CARROT.title: Grilled Carrot
SHIONTHEBRUISER-TRAINING_MANUAL.descript: Whenever you enter an Elite or Boss room, [gold]Upgrade[/gold] a random card in your [gold]Deck[/gold].
SHIONTHEBRUISER-TRAINING_MANUAL.flavor: A book from another world Shion brought over to help her and others train. But, uh, it seems very focused on racing...?
SHIONTHEBRUISER-TRAINING_MANUAL.title: Training Manual
SHIONTHEBRUISER-SIGNATURE_RACEWEAR.descr: Whenever you play a [gold]Non-Native[/gold] card, gain {Block:diff()} [gold]Block[/gold].
SHIONTHEBRUISER-SIGNATURE_RACEWEAR.flavo: A certain racer's signature outfit. Whatever you do, do NOT let Shion wear it. It makes her incredibly worse as a person.
SHIONTHEBRUISER-SIGNATURE_RACEWEAR.title: Signature Racewear
SHIONTHEBRUISER-CREATIVE_SPARK.descripti: At the start of each combat, ALL your cards gain [gold]Novel[/gold]. Cards you create also gain [gold]Novel[/gold].
SHIONTHEBRUISER-CREATIVE_SPARK.flavor: That one thing that drives you to create.
SHIONTHEBRUISER-CREATIVE_SPARK.title: Creative Spark
SHIONTHEBRUISER-CREATIVE_FLOW.descriptio: Add [gold]Novel[/gold] to ALL your cards and the ones you create. At the start of combat, gain [blue]{Memory}[/blue] [gold]Memory[/gold].
SHIONTHEBRUISER-CREATIVE_FLOW.flavor: You found your muse. You would do anything for her.
SHIONTHEBRUISER-CREATIVE_FLOW.title: Creative Flow
SHIONTHEBRUISER-JUICER.title: Juicer
SHIONTHEBRUISER-JUICER.description: Whenever you add a card to your [gold]Deck[/gold], raise your Max HP by {MaxHp:diff()}.
SHIONTHEBRUISER-JUICER.flavor: The simplest solution to transform wild fruits into a delicious treat.
SHIONTHEBRUISER-EVIL_WAFFLE.title: Evil Waffle
SHIONTHEBRUISER-EVIL_WAFFLE.flavor: In its galaxy, it destroys everything by going against the flow. Not here.
SHIONTHEBRUISER-CHAMPAGNE.title: Champagne
SHIONTHEBRUISER-CHAMPAGNE.description: Once per turn, after you've played a Status, a [gold]Common[/gold], an [gold]Uncommon[/gold] and a [gold]Rare[/gold] card, gain {SlipperyPower:diff()} [gold]Slippery[/gold].
SHIONTHEBRUISER-CHAMPAGNE.flavor: The most festive drink there is. It makes everyone happy!
SHIONTHEBRUISER-APPLE_SAUCE.title: Apple Sauce
SHIONTHEBRUISER-APPLE_SAUCE.description:
At the start of combat, add {Cards:diff()} [gold]Slimed[/gold] to your [gold]Draw Pile[/gold].
At the start of your turn, gain {FreeStatus:diff()} [gold]Free Status[/gold].
SHIONTHEBRUISER-APPLE_SAUCE.flavor: Slimes do not taste things like others do. But apples… of course they like apples!…
SHIONTHEBRUISER-WHITE_RIBBON.title: White Ribbon
SHIONTHEBRUISER-WHITE_RIBBON.description: Whenever you play a Power, deal damage to ALL enemies equal to the number of Powers you played this combat.
SHIONTHEBRUISER-WHITE_RIBBON.flavor: A keepsake from a very special person, from a time where she needed rescuing.
SHIONTHEBRUISER-GENIES_ADVICE.title: Genie's Advice
SHIONTHEBRUISER-GENIES_ADVICE.flavor: A genie uses magic to shapeshift. A slime does not, but the process is surprisingly similar.
SHIONTHEBRUISER-SLIME_RIBBON.title: Keyboard Key
SHIONTHEBRUISER-SLIME_RIBBON.description: At the start of each combat, your [gold]Slimy[/gold] cards gain [gold]Replay[/gold].
SHIONTHEBRUISER-SLIME_RIBBON.flavor: Just press hrder on it. t some point it will hve to work.
SHIONTHEBRUISER-FRY_RELIC_TODO1.title: TODO
SHIONTHEBRUISER-FRY_RELIC_TODO1.descript: Whenever you end your turn, gain {singleStarIcon} equal to your remaining energy.
SHIONTHEBRUISER-FRY_RELIC_TODO2.title: TODO
SHIONTHEBRUISER-FRY_RELIC_TODO2.descript:
Whenever you end your turn, gain {singleStarIcon} equal to your remaining energy +{BonusStars}.
Start each combat with {Stars:starIcons()}.
SHIONTHEBRUISER-FRY_RELIC_TODO3.title: TODO
SHIONTHEBRUISER-FRY_RELIC_TODO3.descript: The first time you gain [gold]Damage Debt[/gold] each combat, [gold]Refuse[/gold] {Refuse:diff()}.
SHIONTHEBRUISER-THORN_BRACELET.title: Thorn Bracelet
SHIONTHEBRUISER-THORN_BRACELET.flavor: Blood magic requires blood. This simple tool makes yours accessible.
SHIONTHEBRUISER-THORN_BRACERS.title: Thorn Bracers
SHIONTHEBRUISER-THORN_BRACERS.descriptio:
Whenever you play a [gold]Blood Bend[/gold] card, lose {HpLoss:diff()} HP after it resolves.
Whenever you lose HP, gain {Blood:diff()} [gold]Blood[/gold].
SHIONTHEBRUISER-THORN_BRACERS.flavor: Blood magic requires blood. It can have yours.
SHIONTHEBRUISER-RED_FANG.title: Red Fang
SHIONTHEBRUISER-RED_FANG.flavor: The bony remain of a dangerous predator. It's almost like it's still… thirsty?
SHIONTHEBRUISER-MEGAPHONE.title: Megaphone
SHIONTHEBRUISER-MEGAPHONE.description: Whenever you [gold]Gloat[/gold], apply {VulnerablePower:diff()} [gold]Vulnerable[/gold] to ALL enemies.
SHIONTHEBRUISER-MEGAPHONE.flavor: A ingenious device that helps when one is not LOUD enough.
SHIONTHEBRUISER-LOTTERY_TICKET.title: Lottery Ticket
SHIONTHEBRUISER-LOTTERY_TICKET.descripti: Whenever you play an [gold]Erratic[/gold] card, gain {Energy:energyIcons()}.
SHIONTHEBRUISER-LOTTERY_TICKET.flavor: A small piece of paper with numbers printed on it, hope-filling like nothing else is.
SHIONTHEBRUISER-CERBERUS_TIP.title: Cerberus' Tip
SHIONTHEBRUISER-CERBERUS_TIP.description: The first time you [gold]Blood Bend[/gold] X each combat, heal X HP.
SHIONTHEBRUISER-CERBERUS_TIP.flavor: Thanks to a dimension shattering experience, you know what it's like to have three bodies.
SHIONTHEBRUISER-DRIVING_LICENSE.title: Driving License
SHIONTHEBRUISER-DRIVING_LICENSE.descript: Whenever you create a card, shuffle a copy of that card into your [gold]Discard Pile[/gold].
SHIONTHEBRUISER-DRIVING_LICENSE.flavor: In the Spire, no-one knows what it is. But if needed, you can show you got it.
SHIONTHEBRUISER-SPIDER_TEA.title: Spider Tea
SHIONTHEBRUISER-SPIDER_TEA.description: The first time each turn you draw a card that costs [blue]3[/blue] energy or more, gain {Energy:energyIcons()}.
SHIONTHEBRUISER-SPIDER_TEA.flavor: A spider delicacy, made by spiders, with spiders, for spiders.
SHIONTHEBRUISER-CRYSTAL_GARLAND.title: Crystal Garland
SHIONTHEBRUISER-CRYSTAL_GARLAND.descript: At the start of each Elite or Boss fight, procure a [gold]Blood Potion[/gold].
SHIONTHEBRUISER-CRYSTAL_GARLAND.flavor: One of the wings of a dangerous vampire. The unknown killer was her.
SHIONTHEBRUISER-PURPLE_CHAOS_EMERALDS.de: At the start of each combat, shuffle a [gold]Vision[/gold] into your [gold]Draw Pile[/gold].
SHIONTHEBRUISER-PURPLE_CHAOS_EMERALDS.fl: Seven gems of incredible power. If you bring them into the final fight, then maybe...
SHIONTHEBRUISER-CYAN_CHAOS_EMERALD.title: Cyan Chaos Emerald
SHIONTHEBRUISER-CYAN_CHAOS_EMERALD.descr: At the start of each combat, shuffle an [gold]Emerald Power: Cyan[/gold] into your [gold]Draw Pile[/gold].
SHIONTHEBRUISER-CYAN_CHAOS_EMERALD.flavo: This gem of incredible power is drawn to those with erratic personalities.
SHIONTHEBRUISER-CYAN_CHAOS_EMERALDS.desc: At the start of each combat, shuffle an [gold]Emerald Power: Cyan[/gold] into your [gold]Draw Pile[/gold].
SHIONTHEBRUISER-CYAN_CHAOS_EMERALDS.flav: Seven gems of incredible power. If you bring them into the final fight, then maybe...
SHIONTHEBRUISER-GREEN_CHAOS_EMERALD.desc: At the start of each combat, shuffle a [gold]Double Down[/gold] into your [gold]Draw Pile[/gold].
SHIONTHEBRUISER-GREEN_CHAOS_EMERALD.flav: This gem of incredible power is drawn to those with a lone wolf's heart.
SHIONTHEBRUISER-GREEN_CHAOS_EMERALDS.des: At the start of each combat, shuffle a [gold]Double Down[/gold] into your [gold]Draw Pile[/gold].
SHIONTHEBRUISER-GREEN_CHAOS_EMERALDS.fla: Seven gems of incredible power. If you bring them into the final fight, then maybe...
SHIONTHEBRUISER-YELLOW_CHAOS_EMERALD.des:
The first card you play each combat is free.
The first card you buy at each [gold]Merchant[/gold] is free.
SHIONTHEBRUISER-YELLOW_CHAOS_EMERALD.fla: This gem of incredible power is drawn to those whose personality shine the brightest.
SHIONTHEBRUISER-YELLOW_CHAOS_EMERALDS.de:
The first card you play each combat is free.
The first card you buy at each [gold]Merchant[/gold] is free.
SHIONTHEBRUISER-YELLOW_CHAOS_EMERALDS.fl: Seven gems of incredible power. If you bring them into the final fight, then maybe...
SHIONTHEBRUISER-BLUE_CHAOS_EMERALD.title: Blue Chaos Emerald
SHIONTHEBRUISER-BLUE_CHAOS_EMERALD.descr: Whenever you gain [gold]Energy[/gold] from a card, gain {Energy:energyIcons()} more.
SHIONTHEBRUISER-BLUE_CHAOS_EMERALD.flavo: This gem of incredible power is drawn to those with massive knowledge.
SHIONTHEBRUISER-BLUE_CHAOS_EMERALDS.desc: Whenever you gain [gold]Energy[/gold] from a card, gain {Energy:energyIcons()} more.
SHIONTHEBRUISER-BLUE_CHAOS_EMERALDS.flav: Seven gems of incredible power. If you bring them into the final fight, then maybe...
SHIONTHEBRUISER-RED_CHAOS_EMERALD.title: Red Chaos Emerald
SHIONTHEBRUISER-RED_CHAOS_EMERALD.descri: Whenever you apply [gold]Vulnerable[/gold], gain that much [gold]Block[/gold] and heal {Heal:diff()} HP.
SHIONTHEBRUISER-RED_CHAOS_EMERALD.flavor: This gem of incredible power is drawn to those whose blood runs hot.
SHIONTHEBRUISER-RED_CHAOS_EMERALDS.title: Chaos Emeralds
SHIONTHEBRUISER-RED_CHAOS_EMERALDS.descr: Whenever you apply [gold]Vulnerable[/gold], gain that much [gold]Block[/gold] and heal {Heal:diff()} HP.
SHIONTHEBRUISER-RED_CHAOS_EMERALDS.flavo: Seven gems of incredible power. If you bring them into the final fight, then maybe...
SHIONTHEBRUISER-GREY_CHAOS_EMERALD.title: Grey Chaos Emerald
SHIONTHEBRUISER-GREY_CHAOS_EMERALD.descr: At the end of each fight, enchant a random card in your [gold]Deck[/gold] with [gold]Glam[/gold].
SHIONTHEBRUISER-GREY_CHAOS_EMERALD.flavo: This gem of incredible power is drawn to the occult and the queer alike.
SHIONTHEBRUISER-GREY_CHAOS_EMERALDS.desc: At the end of each fight, enchant a random card in your [gold]Deck[/gold] with [gold]Glam[/gold].
SHIONTHEBRUISER-GREY_CHAOS_EMERALDS.flav: Seven gems of incredible power. If you bring them into the final fight, then maybe...
SHIONTHEBRUISER-FRIENDSHIP_BRACELET.desc:
Choose a [gold]Team-Up[/gold] card to add to your [gold]Deck[/gold]: one for each class in your party, and one that works with anyone.
Add a random [gold]Curse[/gold] to your [gold]Deck[/gold].
SHIONTHEBRUISER-FRIENDSHIP_BRACELET.flav: What a cutie! You love your friends, don't you? Yes, you do!!
SHIONTHEBRUISER-POWER_CORE.title: Power Core
SHIONTHEBRUISER-POWER_CORE.description:
Choose 1 of [blue]3[/blue] [gold]Team Blast[/gold] cards to add to your [gold]Deck[/gold]: your character's own if it has one, the others generic.
Add a random [gold]Curse[/gold] to your [gold]Deck[/gold].
SHIONTHEBRUISER-POWER_CORE.flavor: This intriguing orb from another world can interface with an organic or synthetic being to confer them elemental powers. Those elements, of course, being 'fast', 'strong', or 'high'.
SHIONTHEBRUISER-STAR_ROD.title: Star Rod
SHIONTHEBRUISER-STAR_ROD.description: [gold]Galvanised[/gold] Attacks apply, at random, one of these effects: {WeakPower:diff()} [gold]Weak[/gold], {VulnerablePower:diff()} [gold]Vulnerable[/gold], {Confusion:diff()} [gold]Confusion[/gold], {DoomPower:diff()} [gold]Doom[/gold] or {PoisonPower:diff()} [gold]Poison[/gold].
SHIONTHEBRUISER-STAR_ROD.flavor: Crystalised dreams make up this powerful artefact from another world. If you breathe your own into it, nothing is impossible!
SHIONTHEBRUISER-CURSED_DICE.title: Cursed Dice
SHIONTHEBRUISER-CURSED_DICE.description:
Upon pickup, add [gold]Gambling Addiction[/gold] to your [gold]Deck[/gold].
Your card rewards gain an additional [gold]Gamble[/gold] card.
SHIONTHEBRUISER-CURSED_DICE.flavor: You lost everything, which is just enough to buy you the right to never ever stop trying.
SHIONTHEBRUISER-WHIMSICAL_HAT.title: Whimsical Hat
SHIONTHEBRUISER-WHIMSICAL_HAT.descriptio:
At the start of combat, shuffle {Cards:diff()} [gold]Dazed[/gold] into your [gold]Draw Pile[/gold].
At the end of your turn, play a random [gold]Ethereal[/gold] card in your [gold]Hand[/gold].
SHIONTHEBRUISER-WHIMSICAL_HAT.flavor: Hoof-knitted by a traveling magician, now a memento of a resentful procuror.
